headline: Ocarina of Time: The first 3D Zelda
title: Zelda Ocarina of Time Facts | First 3D Zelda | Classic Games
video_script: The Legend of Zelda, Ocarina of Time launched in November nineteen ninety eight, developed and published by Nintendo for the Nintendo sixty four. It was the first Zelda game with three D graphics, and the fifth in the series. Its target lock system and context sensitive buttons later became common in three D adventure games. Nintendo released an enhanced version, Ocarina of Time three D, on the three D S in twenty eleven. Best Zelda ever? Comment below!
